document_title: Four score and seven years ago our fathers brought forth, upon this continent, a new nation, conceived in liberty, and dedicated to the proposition that "all men are created equal."
author: Abraham Lincoln
claims: The speech was delivered at a battlefield of a great civil war.
The purpose was to dedicate a portion of the battlefield as a final resting place for those who died there, so that the nation might live.
The speaker stated that the brave men who struggled there had hallowed the ground far above our poor power to add or detract.
The speaker suggested the world will little note, nor long remember what is said, but will never forget what the soldiers did.
The living are dedicated to the great task remaining before them.
The living should take increased devotion to the cause for which the dead gave the last full measure of devotion.
The dead shall not have died in vain.
The nation shall have a new birth of freedom.
Government of the people, by the people, for the people, shall not perish from the earth.
